description.value: Taka's Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in the coastal community of White Rock, offering both lunch and dinner service with online ordering. The restaurant also accepts Omakase reservation requests by phone or email for a curated chef's-choice dining experience. Its location on Pacific Avenue puts it within easy reach of cyclists exploring the South Surrey and White Rock waterfront.
